source.value: Rippers Unmasked — The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Detonate Phantasm)

summary.value: You overflow one Phantasm with energy, making it explode to devastating effect.

system.description: You overflow one Phantasm with energy, making it explode to devastating effect. Choose a damage type: light or dark. The target hit by this spell suffers (HR + 25) damage of the chosen type. This shatters the Phantasm.
